source_stage: Final restored buffering policy, WAL pre-growth boundary fix, and snapshot-retirement checkpoint barrier.

macos_targeted_race.scope: New snapshot recovery cases before metadata publication and during paused checkpoint I/O; snapshot isolation; WAL buffer-budget boundaries for record/raw and heap/native storage; WAL in-flight growth; capture immutability/short writes; concurrent compaction, cache bounds and mapping lifetimes.

regression_proofs.old_snapshot_recovery: Both cases fail verification on previous code after data sync without meta publication: recovered leaf key out of range.
regression_proofs.new_snapshot_recovery: Both cases pass, including three repeated runs and race detector.
regression_proofs.old_wal_boundary: Ordinary boundary allocates 8,388,544 native bytes (or 5,251,072 heap bytes) with a 4,194,304-byte backlog bound.
regression_proofs.new_wal_boundary: All four record/raw × native/heap cases stay within the bound and replay both full values correctly.

linux_runtime_tests.reason: Docker daemon unavailable; no Linux runtime claim for this revision.

comparison_method: 36 serial fresh native fixtures: final, original alpha.6, and prior warmed memory candidate, three repetitions per dataset/order; identical harness. Competitor columns retained from separately completed preceding 48-trial October 27 matrix. Never pool intermediate native candidates.
rejected_tuning: CacheBytes/4 memtable and larger dirty-page targets reduced some peaks but regressed ingestion; final restores prior CacheBytes/2 memtable and CacheBytes/4 dirty-page policy.
